results.wikipedia_summary: Ornithogalum arabicum is a species of star of Bethlehem native to northern Africa and southern Europe. Common names include Arab's eye, lesser cape-lily, and Arabian starflower.

results.wikipedia_summary: Trifolium vesiculosum, the arrowleaf clover, is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. It is native to southeastern and eastern Europe, the northern Caucasus, Turkey, Syria, and Lebanon, and has been introduced to other locales, including the United States and Australia. A cool-season annual, it is a large species reaching 1 m (3 ft) with 5 cm (2 in) leaves.
